recipe.title: Banana Pancake

steps.text: Peel and roughly cut the bananas into pieces
steps.label: Prep bananas

steps.text: Make sure the boiled milk is cooled before using
steps.label: Cool milk

steps.text: Add bananas, egg, and jaggery into a mixer jar and blend until smooth
steps.label: Blend base

steps.text: Add wheat flour and milk to the mixture and blend again to form a smooth batter
steps.label: Make batter

steps.text: Pour the batter into a bowl for mixing
steps.label: Transfer batter

steps.text: Add salt and baking soda, and mix well
steps.label: Add dry ingredients

steps.text: Add a little milk if needed to get a pouring consistency batter
steps.label: Adjust consistency

steps.text: Heat a tawa and add a little butter
steps.label: Heat pan

steps.text: Pour a ladle of batter and let it spread naturally without spreading
steps.label: Pour batter

steps.text: Maintain the flame on medium. Close the pan and cook for a few minutes until one side is done
steps.label: Cook covered
steps.attention_cue: Close the pan and cook for a few minutes

steps.text: Flip and cook the other side until golden
steps.label: Flip pancake

steps.text: Once the pancake is cooked on both sides, remove from the pan and serve hot with chopped bananas or your topping of choice
steps.label: Serve hot
